# Metadata exiftool may find, by file, tag and the SHA-256 of the value
# (the value itself is never written here). Tab-separated; one per line, with
# the reason after the hash. Used by .github/scripts/security-scan.sh. The
# hash is of the value as the scan sees it; to get it for <file> and <tag>:
#   exiftool -json -G1 -a -<tag> <file> | jq -r '.[0]["<tag>"] | tostring' | tr -d '\n' | sha256sum
